context:

Problem (rule): you said in chat at 14:12 CST that the coordinator has your explicit permission to archive seven finished lane sessions, but the hook that guards archives reads only a typed `override`, so all seven stay refused and only you can type it.
Based on (read): the coordinator's relay of 14:17 CST Nov 18; at 14:15 CST it checked that two more lanes have their branches already on main.
Departs from: main — the archive hook accepts only a typed override, not your words in chat — your typed override lets the nine archives go through.
Waiting on: nothing else is stopped; the coordinator archives the seven lanes plus the two whose work is already on main when you type the word; a tenth lane's work was replaced by a newer ruling, and archiving it is optional.
